Read per-hexagon topic probabilities

Source: R/read.R
punkst_read_topics.Rd

Read per-hexagon topic probabilities

Usage

punkst_read_topics(model)

Arguments

model

A punkstModel fitted with transform = TRUE, or the path to a *.results.tsv file.

Value

A data frame with columns key, x, y and one column per topic (named as written by punkst). The keys are random and not unique; match hexagons by position with match_xy().

Examples

f <- tempfile(fileext = ".results.tsv")
writeLines(c("key\tx\ty\t0\t1", "a\t1.5\t2.5\t0.9\t0.1", "b\t3.5\t4.5\t0.2\t0.8"), f)
punkst_read_topics(f)
#>   key   x   y   0   1
#> 1   a 1.5 2.5 0.9 0.1
#> 2   b 3.5 4.5 0.2 0.8
